If you're new to the WhoaVerse, welcome! If you've been here for a while, great! But there are some things that aren't being used to it's fullest. Firstly, we have a dedicated IRC channel. Typically, when there's something going on with WhoaVerse, like TheFappening spike and DDoS attack we had a few days ago, the IRC channel is the place to be, regarding real time coverage and discussion. While some might not find it a means to hop on, what you're experiencing with the site can be discussed right then and there, instead of posting a new discussion and squatting on your post for answers. Atko does hop on when something is going on (usually), so getting on IRC will also give you the chance to interact with the WhoaVerse creator.

We have a small amount of users that are on the IRC channel consistently. But I believe we can do better. After all, the users are important for building the site, as well. And congregating in the channel will open up an awesome opportunity to come together more as a community.

If you've never used IRC or don't want to have to download the software to join, no problem. You can join via browser by going here: WhoaVerse Channel

If you're familiar with IRC and already have the software, we're at: irc.freenode.net/6667 #whoaverse

We also have a facebook page! WhoaVerse Facebook

Just by liking and sharing the page, you are helping WhoaVerse build its community.

Finally, there is a WhoaVerse Facebook group. But the group is staying hidden until Atko gives the go-ahead to make it public. Whether the group is utilized or not, it at least will be the only official (or not official) group with the name WhoaVerse, with out deviations.

Anyways, I hope I've reached out to some to get more involved with the community. Without yous guys, there wouldn't be a WhoaVerse.
